messages:
maria.p: quick heads-up — packaging rc5 for private/vpc installer (1.4.3-rc5). need signoff on manifest pin before we hand to transport. target canary window 2026-04-02 22:00Z. checksum + cosign ready.

alex.k: taking a look, will validate image pins and KMS access. if nothing funky I'll sign off by EOD today.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary: private-vpc/1.4.3-rc5 -> 2 canary hosts 2026-04-02T22:00Z -> 2026-04-03T02:00Z. Hooks: post-install healthcheck, telemetry-sample, auto-rollback on >5% error rate.

sam.ops: KMS rotation check — are we using customer KMS key alias "redwood/customer-123/kms"? need to ensure transport manifest references the right key.

jen: rollback criteria proposal: immediate rollback if installer fails on >10% of hosts in first 30m; otherwise manual rollback if regressions in metrics >5% across 1h. also pin fallback image to 1.4.2-stable.

alex.k: manifest snippet:
```
image: registry.private.example.com/redwood/inference:1.4.3-rc5
digest: sha256:bcda1234f3e2d9e7a1b4c6f8e9d0a1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234
installer_manifest_version: v2
kms_key_alias: "redwood/customer-123/kms"
```
cosign verify command:
```
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/keys/redwood-cosign image@sha256:bcda1234f3e2d9e7a1b4c6f8e9d0a1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234
```

maria.p: tagging release notes: i'll add the packaging / airgap steps and the transport checksum section. @alex.k please paste final digest so I can include.

deploy-bot: Canary start event: 2026-04-02T22:00:00Z. Monitoring hooks enabled. If auto-rollback triggers, will post summary + rollback commit.

jen: add customer-facing note for Private docs: include 'how to verify signatures and run offline verifier' checkboxes.

alex.k: final digest is sha256:bcda1234f3e2d9e7a1b4c6f8e9d0a1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef1234. pushed and signed. all checklist items green from my side. :thumbsup: 

maria.p: thanks — i'm green too. proceeding to hand to transport later today. will keep this thread updated if anything changes. :package:
